title: Leidos Lands $95M DLA Contract to Apply AI to Asset Management
script:
Leidos just secured a ninety-five million dollar contract from the Defense Logistics Agency.
The company will use AI to improve enterprise asset management for the agency.
This initiative focuses on enhancing visibility and readiness across the DLA logistics network.
Leidos will provide technical support to modernize their aging information technology infrastructure.
The contract includes a five-year base period of performance for the team.
It aims to streamline how the agency tracks and maintains critical military equipment.
Will this AI overhaul finally fix defense inventory tracking?
